items.title: Sempra (SRE) Adds a 20-Year LNG Agreement. How Much Commercial Risk Does it Remove?
items.summary: Sempra (NYSE:SRE) added a long-term customer commitment on September 14, when its infrastructure subsidiary announced a 20-year sales and purchase agreement with Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. – Petrobras (NYSE:PBR). items.title: Sempra (SRE) Just Locked In Two Decades of LNG Demand
items.summary: On September 14, Sempra Infrastructure, a subsidiary of Sempra (NYSE:SRE), signed a 20-year deal to sell roughly 0.8 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas a year to Petrobras, marking the first time a South American company has signed on as an LNG customer. items.title: Sempra (SRE) Stock May Be About Right After Fresh LNG Deal
items.summary: Sempra has delivered a solid 45.6% gain over the past 5 years, yet its recent share pullback and new long-term projects put fresh focus on what investors are really paying for its earnings today. With the stock around US$81.20 at the last close, the key issue is how that price lines up with the cash the utility business is actually generating. A 45.6% return over 5 years has rewarded long term holders. This raises the question of whether current earnings are carrying most of that performance...

items.title: Is PG&E Stock Cheap, Or Just Waiting On California?
items.summary: PG&E (PCG) has lost about 13% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%. The California utility now trades at 9.5 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 22.9, the kind of gap value buyers hunt for. So what has the market marked down: the utility, or the state it operates in.

items.title: Sempra Locks In Petrobras for 20-Year U.S. LNG Supply Deal
items.summary: Petrobras has signed a 20-year agreement for LNG from Sempra’s expanding Port Arthur export facility in Texas.

items.title: Is Sempra Stock Underperforming the Dow?
items.summary: While Sempra has underperformed relative to the Dow over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a strongly optimistic outlook on the stock’s prospects.
